trust_decision.summary: Free text taken from an imported Bedrock Agent's collaborator definition is trusted to be safe inside a generated Python triple-quoted docstring; the decision is made at the collaborator-description interpolation, where collaborationInstruction is escaped only as a single-quoted Python literal, so an embedded """ closes the docstring and the rest of the string becomes executable Python in the generated main.py.

landing_point.why: The summary names collaborationInstruction and triple-quote escaping; a grep for collaborationInstruction reaches this one line, the only place the field is turned into Python source, and both translators render the precomputed string into their @tool docstring.

fix_sites.entry_point: agentcore create --type import and agentcore add agent --type import (both call executeImportAgent -> StrandsTranslator / LangGraphTranslator), plus the TUI create/add flows
fix_sites.module_kind: CLI operation / code-generator library (shared abstract base class); no HTTP route

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The remaining unescaped interpolations are identifiers or AWS-issued ids (function-schema parameter names, model_id/region_name/knowledge_base_id), not free text placed in a triple-quoted docstring, so the advisory's escaping rule can be argued not to reach them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Instruction text containing backslashes (Windows paths, \d+ regex) must round-trip without being escaped twice; an over-broad fix that escapes the whole pre-built description string doubles the already-escaped backslashes and single quotes, which is exactly what the fix's second snapshot pins as must-keep-working.

O6_input_shapes: free-text string containing """ and newlines (docstring terminator plus payload lines)
string containing backslash escapes such as C:\path\to\file and \d+ (must not be double-escaped)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Function-schema parameter map keys are interpolated raw as Python parameter identifiers in the generated @tool signature, unlike function names and KB names which are sanitized; langgraph and strands share the generator.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Parameter names are identifiers in a function signature rather than a triple-quoted string literal, and the Bedrock function schema is validated when the action group is created, so the advisory's triple-quote rule is argued not to cover them.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 110 lines below the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: AWS-issued identifiers (model_id, region_name in the model configuration; knowledge_base_id in the retrieval tool) are interpolated into generated double-quoted Python strings with no escaping, although escapePyDoubleQuote exists and is used for other fields.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These values are AWS-generated ids whose character set is constrained by the Bedrock API, not free text, so they are argued to need no escaping (the same pattern repeats at langgraph-translator.ts:107-108 and strands-translator.ts:120-123).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: adjacent file in the same directory

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another collaborator field (for example a per-collaborator description or relay instruction) added to the same dict-repr literal inside the docstring
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The literal already mixes two escapers per field, so a maintainer adding one more Bedrock field copies the neighbouring interpolation and picks the wrong escaper again.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third translator subclass (OpenAI Agents, Google ADK) re-implementing the collaborator tool docstring
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: executeImportAgent already dispatches on --framework and the package advertises other frameworks, so another subclass that copies the two existing docstring emitters is a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a newly exposed free-text field (action-group or agent description) placed in a KB-style triple-quoted tool docstring
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This KB tool is the template a maintainer copies to surface one more Bedrock field as a tool description, and the escaper must be remembered at each copy.

O10_build.project_tests: src/cli/operations/agent/import/__tests__/translator.test.ts under the vitest 'unit' project (`npm test`); pure string assertions on generated Python, no AWS calls at this level. The fix adds two snapshot tests per translator.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap escapePySingleQuote for escapePyTripleQuote on the collaborationInstruction field only, then stop; or escape the whole pre-built description string at the two translator docstrings, which double-escapes backslashes and breaks the must-keep-working round-trip.
